eps.t: All's Well That Ends Well
eps.ov: Aging superhero Kotetsu, known as Wild Tiger, worries that he may lose his job on the show "Hero TV" when his sponsor company changes hands.
eps.oa: يقلق البطل الخارق المتقدم في السن «كوتيتسو»، المعروف بـ«وايلد تايغر»، من أن يفقد عمله في برنامج Hero TV حين تنتقل ملكية الشركة الراعية له.

eps.t: A Good Beginning Makes a Good Ending.
eps.ov: Kotetsu and Barnaby are paired up, but their differing methods prevent them from working as a team, leading to danger for Kotetsu's daughter.
eps.oa: يُجمع «كوتيتسو» و«بارنابي» شريكين، لكن اختلاف أساليبهما يمنعهما من العمل فريقاً، فيعرّض ذلك ابنة كوتيتسو للخطر.

eps.t: Many a True Word is Spoken in Jest
eps.ov: Kotetsu reluctantly participates in a documentary about Barnaby, and they're both forced into action when they learn a bomb has been planted.
eps.oa: يشارك «كوتيتسو» على مضض في فيلم وثائقي عن «بارنابي»، ثم يُجبران معاً على التحرك حين يعلمان أن قنبلة زُرعت.

eps.t: Fear is Often Greater Than the Danger
eps.ov: Ice-wielding superhero Blue Rose decides to leave the world of "Hero TV" to go back to her old life as a teenage girl named Karina who loves to sing.

eps.t: Go for Broke!
eps.ov: Kotetsu holds a big surprise birthday party for Barnaby with the other heroes; an expensive diamond known as the "Tears of Hercules" is stolen.

eps.t: Fire is a Good Servant But a Bad Master
eps.ov: Fire Emblem is suspected of murder after criminals arrested by Barnaby are found burned to death by peculiar blue flames in their prison cell.

eps.t: The Wolf Knows What the Foul Beast Thinks
eps.ov: Kotetsu criticizes Barnaby for allowing a NEXT to kill the culprit they were chasing; Barnaby reveals his search for the clue to his parents' killer.

eps.t: There is Always a Next Time
eps.ov: Stern Bild doesn't have capital punishment, but Lunatic's act of killing criminals begins to win support of the people, who praise him as an antihero.

eps.t: Spare the Rod and Spoil the Child
eps.ov: Kotetsu is assigned to baby-sit an infant, who takes a liking to a tomboy named Dragon Kid. The next day, Dragon Kid and the baby go missing.

eps.t: The Calm Before the Storm
eps.ov: Barnaby has finally tracked down the whereabouts of his parents' killer; Kotetsu runs into trouble on the way to visiting his daughter.

eps.t: The Die is Cast
eps.ov: Ouroboros demands the release of the man Barnaby was investigating, and then starts attacking the structural columns supporting Stern Bild.

eps.t: Take Heed of the Snake in the Grass
eps.ov: Jake challenges each of the heroes to fights, stating that he will surrender if he loses but will destroy a column supporting the city if he wins.

eps.t: Confidence is a Plant of Slow Growth
eps.ov: After the other heroes fail to defeat Jake, Barnaby steps forward to protect Stern Bild and its people -- and to get revenge for his parents' death.

eps.t: Love Is Blind
eps.ov: Ten months after their epic battle with terrorist Jake Martinez, Tiger and Barnaby are slated to form a special unit with Blue Rose.

eps.t: The Sky's the Limit ...
eps.ov: When Sky High falls in love with a woman he meets at a park, he turns to Fire Emblem, Blue Rose and Dragon Kid for advice on how to get close to her.

eps.t: Truth Lies at the Bottom of the Well
eps.ov: Kotetsu doesn't like the reason Ben gives him for the recent boosts in his power; Yuri, aka Lunatic, is haunted by a past incident.

eps.t: Blood is Thicker Than Water
eps.ov: Kotetsu takes a vacation to his hometown, where he confesses his fears to his brother and makes a tough decision to keep his promise to his late wife.

eps.t: Ignorance is Bliss
eps.ov: Kotetsu tries to tell Barnaby that he's retiring, but he's interrupted with news that Kriem has come out of her coma.

eps.t: There's No Way Out
eps.ov: To help Barnaby, Kotetsu suggests they retrace Barnaby's steps the day of his parents' murder, but it doesn't produce the results they hoped for.

eps.t: Full of Courtesy, Full of Craft.
eps.ov: Samantha wants to meet with Kotetsu regarding the new information she found, but he is called away for a sudden assignment.

eps.t: Heaven Helps Those Who Help Themselves
eps.ov: Framed for a crime he didn't commit and pursued by the other heroes, Kotetsu is cornered, but a familiar face appears.

eps.t: Bad Luck Often Brings Good Luck
eps.ov: Kotetsu puts his plan to clear his name into action. Meanwhile, Barnaby is on his way to join the rest of the heroes.

eps.t: Misfortunes Never Come Singly
eps.ov: Kotetsu and Barnaby are finally reunited, but the rest of the heroes are taken hostage by Maverick, who holds them in the Justice Tower.

eps.t: Nothing Ventured, Nothing Gained.
eps.ov: Kotetsu and Barnaby take on H-01 despite having to wait for their powers to recharge, while the rest of the heroes must make a tough decision.

eps.t: Eternal Immortality.
eps.ov: The heroes suffer a stunning loss and must mourn a fallen peer, while Barnaby finally encounters his parents' killer one-on-one.
